name: National Assembly of Malawi
notes: 229 constituency seats after the 16 September 2025 election. The Electoral Commission declared 224; the other 5 show as Vacant. DPP 78 matches the IPU Parline election page and the EU observation mission's final report, which also gives UDF 4; the other counts are from press and Wikipedia tallies. The IPU page could not be fetched by script and the Assembly's own site gave no list, so the split is secondary and may change with by-elections and independents joining parties. No member is named; no supporter sits.
